# ◆ CHARON

native tidal recorder for macos. Captures only the output of the tidal player process, bit-exact, with sample-exact track cuts, a verify verdict, and tags and cover from tidal. Private, for a personal archive. The sections below are the app's README and its handover format.

## ◆ 741 STATUS

- the README (section 741) describes Charon registering each finished recording in `collection.741` through the agent. Per track: tags, ISRC, tidal id in `streams`, technical data, file path under the music root, verdict in `x.charon.verdict`. Per queue run: one playlist (default name `Charon {date}`).
- duplicate check before recording: by tidal id or ISRC. Policy `ask` (default), `skip` or `record`.
- without an agent, writes wait in the client outbox. Recording never waits for the agent.
- settings are in `settings.json` today (the `coll741*` keys). Target: `setting` records of app `charon`.
- the integration plan lists the Charon reads of the nml collection and the handover file as removed. The README is the current description of what the app does.

## ◆ HANDOVER FROM STYX

STYX places a playlist file in the Charon inbox. Format and rules: section below.




native tidal recorder for macos. takes the audio straight from the tidal player process, bit-exact, cuts every track on the sample and tags it.
built for my own archive -> private, not for distribution.

## ◆ WHY

**bit-exact**
* core audio process tap on `TIDALPlayer` only -> no system sounds, no other apps, system volume does not matter
* output device follows the source rate (44.1 / 48 / 96 / 192 kHz) -> no resampling in the path
* every track is checked against the 16 / 24-bit grid. off grid = flagged, never silently kept
* device not able to run the source rate -> recorded at the highest rate it has, marked `RESAMPLED` with both rates in the tags (fallback off: the track fails with a message)

**clean cuts**
* charon drives playback itself -> it knows when a track starts and ends instead of guessing from silence
* sample-exact boundaries from player events + the tap's sample clock, refined on digital silence
* length is checked against the track duration. mismatch -> `UNGENAU`

**re-record instead of guessing**
* pause, seek, device change or a gap inside the track -> the track is recorded again, once
* a gap that stays -> `UNGENAU`, flagged in the queue

**tags**
* artist, album artist, title, album, track / disc number, year, isrc, tidal id, cover straight from tidal
* the verdict is stored in the file (`charon_verify`), so the archive shows it later

## ◆ FORMATS

choose the quality in charon, tidal is started with the matching setting.

tidal quality (setting, tidal is started with it):

| quality | tidal | stream |
|---|---|---|
| MAX | HI_RES_LOSSLESS | up to 24 / 192, cd tracks stay 16 / 44.1 |
| HIGH / LOW | HIGH / LOW | aac 320 / aac 96 |

output format (setting, any quality works with any format):

| format | file |
|---|---|
| FLAC | flac, source rate and depth, vorbis tags + cover |
| ALAC | m4a alac, tags + cover |
| AAC | m4a, 256 kbit default, tags + cover |
| WAV | pcm, id3 tags, no cover |
| AIFF | pcm, id3 tags + cover |
| MP3 | lame, 320 kbit default, id3 tags + cover |

lossy formats are encoded from the same capture; the verdict describes the capture, not the lossy file.

## ◆ HOW IT WORKS

* two processes: the gui shows and sends commands, `charon-engine` does the work. the engine keeps running without a window, the queue survives a gui restart
* tidal desktop runs hidden in the background, the engine controls it -> no window, your login is reused
* paste a track, album, playlist or mix link, `⌥-click` a link in the built-in browser, or press play in the browser -> the track goes into the queue
* queue: album and playlist links are resolved to single tracks, reorder, retry, remove. the status line shows the phase of the running track

**per track**
* `liest` → resolves the track and its playback format (sample rate, bit depth)
* `stellt gerät auf 96 khz` → sets the device rate, only when the next track needs another one
* `wartet auf tidal` → tap starts, tidal plays the track from 0:00
* `nimmt auf` → recording with live level, frames and verdict, progress from the track duration
* `schneidet` → cut on the sample, `prüft` → bit-grid and gap check, `schreibt` → encoder with tags and cover
* then the next track; `■ stopp` drops the running track

**mithören**
* `mithören` off (default): the player is muted while charon records. on: you hear the track while it is recorded. switch in settings or the status bar

## ◆ ARCHIVE

* files go to `outputFolder` (default `~/Music/Charon-741`), named by the pattern in settings
* pattern uses `/` for folders: `{albumartist}/{album}/{disc}-{track:02} {title}` (placeholders: title, artist, albumartist, album, year, isrc, quality, track, disc, playlist, playlistpos)
* empty placeholders drop out together with their `/`
* archive view reads tags and verdict of every file, `skip existing` leaves files that are already there
* libraries: archive and own folders as read-only sources, shown next to the archive. the converter reads them too, with a track list (search, multi-select)

## ◆ BROWSER

* built-in tidal web player with login (same account as the tidal app, sign in at the top right)
* jumps to playlists, albums, tracks, mixes; ⌥-click on a tidal link -> queue, play in the browser -> recorded at once
* charon does not play through the browser, the recording always comes from tidal desktop

## ◆ CONVERTER

* drop files or folders (recursive, audio only) -> convert to any format above
* uses the same ffmpeg encoder, samples are not changed; source tags and cover are kept

## ◆ RUN IT

needs macos 15+, xcode / swift 6, tidal desktop, ffmpeg (`brew install ffmpeg`).

```
scripts/make-app.sh            # build/741-Charon.app (gui + charon-engine)
scripts/make-app.sh --install  # same, copies to /Applications/741-Charon.app
open build/741-Charon.app
```

first start: system settings -> privacy & security -> screen & system audio recording -> allow 741-Charon (the app that starts the engine). the grant sticks to the signature:
* with a code-signing certificate named `Charon-741 Dev` in the keychain, `make-app.sh` signs with it and the grant survives rebuilds
* the bundle id `com.slayer7411.charon741` stays the same, so the grant follows the renamed app; check it after the first install. an old `Charon-741.app` in /Applications can be deleted by hand
* without it, the build is ad-hoc signed -> after each rebuild the grant may have to be given again

## ◆ TESTS

```
scripts/check.sh          # build + unit tests (core, capture, engine, tidal, ipc)
scripts/check.sh --quick  # build only
scripts/e2e.sh            # offline end to end: synthetic pcm -> encoder -> ffmpeg, bit by bit
scripts/coverage.sh       # line coverage per target
```

* unit: link parsing, file naming, settings, formats, grid check, segmenter, gaps, rate choice, retry, queue, ipc, auth retry
* `charon verify <files|folder>`: rate, depth, real bit depth, grid, digital silence at start / end, loud first / last samples (cut suspicion), jumps between consecutive album tracks
* `charon compare a b`: bit-identical check with sample offset, for recording the same track twice
* e2e: flac / alac / wav / aiff / aac round trips, flac -> alac -> flac bit-identical, tags and cover in the files, deliberately off-grid signal -> `UNGENAU`. output in `tmp/e2e/offline`
* live (tidal running, system audio grant needed, never in ci):

```
CHARON_E2E_TIDAL=1 CHARON_E2E_TRACKS=id1,id2 swift test --filter tidal
CHARON_E2E_TIDAL=1 CHARON_E2E_ALBUM=1 swift test --filter tidalAlbumUeberEngine
CHARON_E2E_TIDAL=1 CHARON_E2E_ENGINE_SOCKET=<support>/engine.sock swift test --filter tidal   # attach to running engine
```

debug: `CHARON_DEBUG_EVENTS=1` writes player events (without tokens) to `~/Library/Application Support/Charon-741/events.log`. ci: macos runner, `check.sh`, `e2e.sh`, release build.

## ◆ ARCHITECTURE

```
┌─[ 741-Charon GUI ]────────────────────────────┐
│ swiftui · archive, browser, converter, queue   │
└───────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                    │ unix socket · 4 byte length + json
┌───────────────────▼────────────────────────────┐
│ charon-engine                                  │
│ control   tidal desktop, hidden, cdp + node    │
│ queue     queue.json, one track at a time      │
│ capture   process tap on TIDALPlayer           │
│ clock     mach_continuous_time (incl. sleep)   │
│ cut       player events + sample clock         │
│ verify    16 / 24-bit grid, gaps, length       │
│ write     ffmpeg · tags · cover                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

details, modules and the flow per track -> architecture · prior art -> audials analysis · plans -> engine, tidal control · tests -> testing

status line: `CPU` (engine + player), `LOAD`, `BUF` (device buffer in ms), `DROP` (device overloads + callbacks over budget + dropped buffers, red for a minute after a change), `RAM`. click for details and reset. settings → system → diagnose-log writes `diag.log` (5 mb rotation). -> architecture

## ◆ 741

Charon registers each finished recording in the 741 collection (`collection.741`) through the 741 agent.

- Per track: tags, ISRC, TIDAL id (`streams`), technical data, file path under the music root, and the verify verdict as `x.charon.verdict` (`OK`, `UNGENAU`, `RESAMPLED`).
- Per queue run: one playlist (default `Charon {date}`), so recordings show up in MINOS and ORPHEUS.
- Before recording: duplicate check by TIDAL id or ISRC. Policy `ask` (default) stops the entry, `skip` skips it, `record` ignores the check.
- Automatic (default): on when an agent home is found (`agent.json`, else the Drive default). Without an agent, writes wait in the client outbox. Recording never waits for the agent.
- Settings in `settings.json`: `coll741Enabled`, `coll741Playlist`, `coll741Duplicates`, `coll741WriteISRC`, `coll741WriteTidalID`, `coll741WriteTechnical`, `coll741WriteVerdict`. Changes apply on engine start.
- Open: the music root label `music` needs a matching `device.rootPaths` entry to resolve in other apps.


## ◆ 741-PLAYLIST v1 (STYX to Charon handover)

A playlist from STYX (bandcamp digging) for Charon. STYX writes the file into the inbox folder. Charon reads it, shows the titles for review, and on request creates a tidal playlist.

- folder: `~/Library/Application Support/Charon-741/inbox/`
- name: `741-playlist-<app>-<timestamp>.json`
- write atomically: write `<name>.json.tmp` (or a dot file) first, then rename. Charon reads only `*.json` directly in `inbox/`, and skips files younger than 2 s.
- after reading: `inbox/done/` on success, `inbox/failed/` on error (with `<name>.reason.txt` next to it).

Format:

```json
{
  "format": "741-playlist",
  "version": 1,
  "source": { "app": "styx", "version": "0.4.0", "exported": "2026-11-02T10:15:00Z" },
  "created": "2026-11-02T10:15:00Z",
  "playlist": { "kind": "rb_playlist", "id": "rb-17", "name": "Dubstep Digs" },
  "tracks": [
    {
      "position": 1,
      "id": "4411022",
      "artist": "Koan Sound",
      "title": "Sun Cave (Original Mix)",
      "version": null,
      "album": "Sun Cave EP",
      "label": "Kalahari",
      "duration": 312.4,
      "isrc": "GBXYZ2600001",
      "source": { "bandcamp": { "trackId": 4411022, "pageUrl": "https://example.bandcamp.com/album/sun-cave-ep", "trackIndex": 1 } },
      "localFile": null
    }
  ]
}
```

| field | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `format` | yes | `741-playlist` |
| `version` | yes | `1`. Any other version goes to `failed/` |
| `source.app`, `source.version`, `source.exported` | no | origin, display only |
| `created` | no | ISO 8601 |
| `playlist.kind` | no | `rb_playlist` or `list`. Missing = `list` |
| `playlist.id`, `playlist.name` | no | the name is used for the tidal playlist |
| `tracks[]` | yes | at least one readable title |
| `tracks[].position` | no | order, default 0 |
| `tracks[].id` | no | key for the match cache. Missing: `source.bandcamp.trackId`, else `pageUrl#trackIndex` |
| `tracks[].artist`, `tracks[].title` | yes | a track without them is skipped and counted |
| `tracks[].version`, `album`, `label`, `isrc`, `localFile` | no | `null` or missing = empty |
| `tracks[].duration` | no | seconds, 0 = unknown |
| `tracks[].tidalId` | no | taken over, not searched again |

Rules:

- unknown fields are ignored, so new fields may be added.
- a title without artist or title is skipped; the file stays valid.
- a file without any readable title, or with another version, goes to `failed/`.
- Charon matches each title on tidal (never during a recording), and classifies it as found, unsure (title equal, duration differs or title partly equal), or not on tidal.
- matches are cached by `tracks[].id`. Confirmed decisions survive a new search.
- creating the tidal playlist happens only after a dry-run preview. The new playlist is not public. Existing playlists are never changed.
- Spotify export: not yet.
